front: À mon avis, cette réforme va dans le bon sens.
pronunciation: [ah mohn nah-VYEE, set ray-form vah dahn luh bohn SAHNS]
back: In my opinion, this reform is a step in the right direction.
context: 'Aller dans le bon sens' = to be a step in the right direction.

front: Je suis tout à fait d'accord avec vous sur ce point.
pronunciation: [zhuh swee too tah feh dah-KOR ah-vek voo sür suh PWAN]
back: I completely agree with you on this point.
context: 'Tout à fait' strengthens agreement.

front: Je ne partage pas du tout votre avis.
pronunciation: [zhuh nuh par-tahzh pah dü too voh-trah-VEE]
back: I don't share your view at all.
context: 'Partager un avis' = to share an opinion.

front: Je vois ce que vous voulez dire, mais je ne suis pas convaincu.
pronunciation: [zhuh vwah suh kuh voo voo-lay DEER, meh zhuh nuh swee pah kohn-van-KÜ]
back: I see what you mean, but I'm not convinced.
context: A polite way to disagree.

front: Permettez-moi de vous contredire.
pronunciation: [pehr-meh-tay-MWAH duh voo kohn-truh-DEER]
back: Allow me to contradict you.
context: Formal debate phrase.

front: Vous avez raison en partie.
pronunciation: [voo zah-vay reh-ZOHN ahn par-TEE]
back: You're partly right.
context: 'En partie' = partly.

front: D'un côté, c'est pratique ; de l'autre, ça coûte cher.
pronunciation: [dan koh-TAY, seh prak-TEEK ; duh LOH-truh, sah koot SHEHR]
back: On the one hand it's practical; on the other, it's expensive.
context: 'D'un côté… de l'autre' = on the one hand… on the other.

front: Certes, le projet est ambitieux, mais il est irréaliste.
pronunciation: [SEHRT, luh proh-zheh eh tahn-bee-SYUH, meh ee leh tee-ray-ah-LEEST]
back: Admittedly the project is ambitious, but it's unrealistic.
context: 'Certes… mais' = admittedly… but. A classic concession structure.

front: Il n'en reste pas moins que le chômage augmente.
pronunciation: [eel nahn rest pah MWAN kuh luh shoh-mahzh ohg-MAHNT]
back: The fact remains that unemployment is rising.
context: 'Il n'en reste pas moins que' = the fact remains that.

front: Force est de constater que les résultats sont décevants.
pronunciation: [fors eh duh kohn-stah-TAY kuh lay ray-zül-tah sohn day-suh-VAHN]
back: One has to admit the results are disappointing.
context: 'Force est de constater' = one cannot help but note (formal).

front: Prenons un exemple concret.
pronunciation: [pruh-nohn zan neg-ZAHN-pluh kohn-KREH]
back: Let's take a concrete example.
context: Useful to support an argument.

front: En d'autres termes, il faut agir maintenant.
pronunciation: [ahn DOH-truh TEHRM, eel foh ah-zheer mant-NAHN]
back: In other words, we have to act now.
context: 'En d'autres termes' = in other words.

front: Par conséquent, nous devons revoir notre stratégie.
pronunciation: [par kohn-say-KAHN, noo duh-vohn ruh-vwahr noh-truh strah-tay-ZHEE]
back: Consequently, we must rethink our strategy.
context: Connectors of consequence: donc, par conséquent, c'est pourquoi.

front: En revanche, les jeunes s'informent surtout en ligne.
pronunciation: [ahn ruh-VAHNSH, lay ZHUHN san-FORM sür-too ahn LEE-nyuh]
back: By contrast, young people mostly get their news online.
context: 'En revanche' = on the other hand, by contrast.

front: Quant à moi, je reste sceptique.
pronunciation: [kahn tah MWAH, zhuh rest sep-TEEK]
back: As for me, I remain skeptical.
context: 'Quant à' = as for.

front: Cet argument ne tient pas la route.
pronunciation: [set ar-gü-mahn nuh tyan pah lah ROOT]
back: This argument doesn't hold water.
context: 'Tenir la route' = to hold up, be sound.

front: Vous confondez corrélation et causalité.
pronunciation: [voo kohn-fohn-day koh-ray-lah-SYOHN ay koh-zah-lee-TAY]
back: You're confusing correlation with causation.
context: A key critical-thinking phrase.

front: C'est un raccourci un peu facile.
pronunciation: [seh tan rah-koor-SEE an puh fah-SEEL]
back: That's a bit of an oversimplification.
context: 'Un raccourci' = a shortcut; in debate, a sweeping generalization.

front: Il ne faut pas mettre tout le monde dans le même sac.
pronunciation: [eel nuh foh pah meh-truh tool mohnd dahn luh mem SAK]
back: You shouldn't lump everyone together.
context: 'Mettre dans le même sac' = to lump together.

front: Pourriez-vous préciser votre pensée ?
pronunciation: [poo-ryay-VOO pray-see-zay voh-truh pahn-SAY]
back: Could you clarify what you mean?
context: Formal request for clarification.

front: Laissez-moi finir, s'il vous plaît.
pronunciation: [leh-say-MWAH fee-NEER, seel voo PLEH]
back: Let me finish, please.
context: When interrupted in a debate.

front: Si je peux me permettre d'intervenir…
pronunciation: [see zhuh puh muh pehr-meh-truh dan-tehr-vuh-NEER]
back: If I may come in here…
context: 'Intervenir' = to speak up, take the floor.

front: Pour résumer, les avis sont partagés.
pronunciation: [poor ray-zü-MAY, lay zah-vee sohn par-tah-ZHAY]
back: To sum up, opinions are divided.
context: 'Les avis sont partagés' = opinions differ.

front: En conclusion, le débat reste ouvert.
pronunciation: [ahn kohn-klü-ZYOHN, luh day-bah rest oo-VEHR]
back: In conclusion, the debate remains open.
context: Closing a discussion.

front: D'après le journal, le ministre va démissionner.
pronunciation: [dah-preh luh zhoor-NAL, luh mee-nees-truh vah day-mee-syoh-NAY]
back: According to the newspaper, the minister is going to resign.
context: 'D'après' / 'selon' = according to.

front: Le ministre aurait menti aux enquêteurs.
pronunciation: [luh mee-nees-truh oh-reh mahn-TEE oh zahn-keh-TUHR]
back: The minister allegedly lied to investigators.
context: The 'journalistic conditional': unconfirmed information. 'Aurait menti' = allegedly lied.

front: Selon une source proche du dossier, l'accord serait signé lundi.
pronunciation: [suh-lohn ün soors prosh dü doh-SYAY, lah-kor suh-reh see-nyay lan-DEE]
back: According to a source close to the matter, the deal will reportedly be signed on Monday.
context: Journalistic conditional for a future event.

front: L'information n'a pas encore été confirmée.
pronunciation: [lan-for-mah-SYOHN nah pah zahn-kor ay-tay kohn-feer-MAY]
back: The information hasn't been confirmed yet.
context: Important caution when reading news.

front: C'est une fausse information qui circule sur les réseaux sociaux.
pronunciation: [seh tün fohs an-for-mah-SYOHN kee seer-kül sür lay ray-zoh soh-SYOH]
back: It's a piece of fake news circulating on social media.
context: Official term 'une fausse information'; also 'une infox' or 'une fake news'.

front: Avant de partager un article, vérifie la source.
pronunciation: [ah-vahn duh par-tah-zhay an nar-TEE-kluh, vay-ree-fee lah SOORS]
back: Before sharing an article, check the source.
context: Basic media literacy.

front: Ce titre est clairement putaclic.
pronunciation: [suh TEE-truh eh klehr-mahn pü-tah-KLEEK]
back: This headline is obviously clickbait.
context: 'Putaclic' = clickbait (very informal and slightly vulgar). Neutral: 'un titre racoleur'.

front: Cette photo a été sortie de son contexte.
pronunciation: [set foh-TOH ah ay-tay sor-tee duh sohn kohn-TEKST]
back: This photo has been taken out of context.
context: 'Sortir de son contexte' = to take out of context.

front: Il s'agit d'une théorie du complot.
pronunciation: [eel sah-zhee dün tay-oh-ree dü kohm-PLOH]
back: It's a conspiracy theory.
context: 'Un complotiste' = a conspiracy theorist.

front: Le site a publié un démenti.
pronunciation: [luh seet ah pü-blee-ay an day-mahn-TEE]
back: The website published a denial.
context: 'Un démenti' = an official denial. 'Démentir' = to deny.

front: Les médias ont relayé l'information sans la vérifier.
pronunciation: [lay may-DYAH ohn ruh-leh-yay lan-for-mah-SYOHN sahn lah vay-ree-FYAY]
back: The media passed on the information without checking it.
context: 'Relayer' = to pass on, spread.

front: Ce journal a une ligne éditoriale plutôt à gauche.
pronunciation: [suh zhoor-nal ah ün LEE-nyuh ay-dee-toh-RYAL plü-toh ah GOHSH]
back: This newspaper has a rather left-leaning editorial line.
context: 'La ligne éditoriale' = editorial stance.

front: Le Monde est un quotidien de référence.
pronunciation: [luh MOHND eh tan koh-tee-DYAN duh ray-fay-RAHNS]
back: Le Monde is a newspaper of record.
context: 'Un quotidien' = a daily paper; 'un hebdomadaire' = a weekly.

front: J'ai lu l'éditorial de ce matin.
pronunciation: [zhay lü lay-dee-toh-RYAL duh suh mah-TAN]
back: I read this morning's editorial.
context: 'L'édito' (informal) = the editorial.

front: Le journaliste a refusé de révéler ses sources.
pronunciation: [luh zhoor-nah-leest ah ruh-fü-zay duh ray-vay-lay say SOORS]
back: The journalist refused to reveal his sources.
context: Protection of sources is a key press principle in France.

front: La liberté de la presse est un pilier de la démocratie.
pronunciation: [lah lee-behr-tay duh lah PRES eh tan pee-lyay duh lah day-moh-krah-SEE]
back: Press freedom is a pillar of democracy.
context: 'Un pilier' = a pillar.

front: Cette chaîne d'info en continu fait beaucoup de sensationnel.
pronunciation: [set shen dan-FOH ahn kohn-tee-NÜ feh boh-koo duh sahn-sah-syoh-NEL]
back: This 24-hour news channel goes in for a lot of sensationalism.
context: 'Une chaîne d'info en continu' = a rolling news channel.

front: L'article est bien documenté.
pronunciation: [lar-tee-kluh eh byan doh-kü-mahn-TAY]
back: The article is well researched.
context: 'Documenté' = well researched, backed by evidence.

front: Ces chiffres sont à prendre avec des pincettes.
pronunciation: [say SHEE-fruh sohn tah prahn-druh ah-vek day pan-SET]
back: These figures should be taken with a grain of salt.
context: 'Prendre avec des pincettes' (with tweezers) = to treat with caution.

front: Le sondage a été réalisé auprès de mille personnes.
pronunciation: [luh sohn-DAHZH ah ay-tay ray-ah-lee-ZAY oh-preh duh meel pehr-SUN]
back: The poll was carried out among a thousand people.
context: 'Un sondage' = a poll. 'Auprès de' = among, with.

front: L'algorithme nous enferme dans une bulle de filtres.
pronunciation: [lal-goh-REETM noo zahn-fehrm dahn zün bül duh FEEL-truh]
back: The algorithm locks us inside a filter bubble.
context: 'Enfermer' = to lock in.

front: Il faut croiser les sources pour se faire une opinion.
pronunciation: [eel foh krwah-zay lay SOORS poor suh fehr ün noh-pee-NYOHN]
back: You need to cross-check sources to form an opinion.
context: 'Croiser les sources' = to cross-check. 'Se faire une opinion' = to form an opinion.

front: Cette vidéo est un deepfake.
pronunciation: [set vee-day-OH eh tan deep-FAYK]
back: This video is a deepfake.
context: French uses the English word; the official term is 'un hypertrucage'.

front: C'est de la propagande pure et simple.
pronunciation: [seh duh lah proh-pah-GAHND pür ay SAN-pluh]
back: It's propaganda, pure and simple.
context: 'Pur et simple' = pure and simple.

front: Le débat a dégénéré en clash.
pronunciation: [luh day-BAH ah day-zhay-nay-RAY ahn KLASH]
back: The debate degenerated into a slanging match.
context: 'Un clash' (informal) = a heated confrontation.

front: Je vous laisse juge.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo les ZHÜZH]
back: I'll let you be the judge.
context: A diplomatic way to end an argument.
